description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2022: Investigation of Wave-Structure Interaction During Post-Earthquake Event Using Real-Time Hybrid Simulation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Daniel Cox, Oregon State University (oregonstate.edu). This project sought to explore if real-time hybrid simulation (RTHS) was a viable solution for the seismic-wave-structure interaction modeling conflict. The data from the project can be reused to further investigate and validate wave impact pressure readings to then compare to the measured load cell forces. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-3gwj-tz06. Keywords: Oregon State University, O.H. Hinsdale Wave Research Laboratory, Real-Time Hybrid Simulation, RTHS, Earthquake, Tsunami. Published 2022-08-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
